summary: BLE feature testing: Home source toggle, Profile connected devices card, Devices screen, backend source field. All 10 feature requirements verified. 12/12 backend tests passed.
action_items: NOTE: Tab bar Profile click via Playwright text selector navigates to 'Your Profile' text (hidden element) — use direct URL or coordinate click. Not a bug, Playwright limitation in React Native web.
NOTE: BLE features (scan/connect) intentionally unavailable in web/Expo Go — Devices screen correctly shows 'Native Build Required' card with Publish CTA as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx: stepSource toggle correctly shows 'STEPS TODAY' when source='phone' and 'BLE STEPS' when source='ble'
home.tsx: BLE Device pill tap when connectedDevice=null correctly fires Alert (not testable in web without triggering alert)
profile.tsx: CONNECTED DEVICES section renders with chevron, taps to router.push('/devices') — verified working
devices.tsx: router.back() returns to profile correctly when history exists (verified via profile→devices→back flow)
server.py: StepsIn.source field defaults to 'phone', accepts 'ble'; stores per-source fields (steps_phone, steps_ble) in MongoDB — verified
seed_data_creation: TEST_device_aerostep_001 profile used from prior iteration
context_for_next_testing_agent: BLE features work correctly in web preview (graceful degradation). Source toggle Pills (Phone/BLE Device) visible on home screen below progress ring. Phone pill highlighted yellow by default. Profile CONNECTED DEVICES card navigates to /devices. Devices shows Native Build Required. Back button returns to Profile. Backend /api/steps accepts source field (phone|ble).
